scenarios.S1: legal TCP Reno plus 8 UDP CBR attackers; mitigation=none
scenarios.S2_rate_limit: attack plus one stock NS-2 TBF drop policer per attacker at CIR 4 Mb/s, attached 0.25 s after attack start
scenarios.S2_isolation: attacking UDP agents are redirected to a local discard sink 0.25 s after attack start; already-created optical bursts drain normally

reconstructed-assumption.tbf_scope: one ingress token bucket per attacking UDP source
reconstructed-assumption.randomization: CBR random_=0 within each run; each seed selects one reproducible run-level attack multiplier uniformly from [0.8,1.2], shared by all attackers and paired attack/mitigation cells
reconstructed-assumption.receiver_selection: all attackers target legal receiver electronic node 9
reconstructed-assumption.nam_trace: disabled to keep pilot raw artifacts bounded; trace-all text is retained

interpretation_limits: The thesis does not supply its original topology/configuration/raw traces, so this is not a bit-for-bit reproduction.
No parameter was tuned to force agreement with thesis result tables.
TBF is the stock NS-2 token bucket, not a reconstructed RFC 2698 two-rate three-color marker because PIR/CBS/PBS/color policy were not specified.
Pilot runs are execution/integration checks, not inferential results.
